$comment: Project policy for the hooks in this directory, in the Hatchery base's format (its ADR 0006; the loader is policy.js). Every script here and ../statusline.js is the base's and reads this file (ADR 0035). git: agents push and lease-push task/* only, never commit on main or master, delete a task/* branch only after a merged PR, and core.hooksPath stays tools/git-hooks. usage: hold 75 on both meters; deny 100, so an owner's grant in ~/.claude/usage-gate-overrides/ lifts either meter or both; DYSTOPO_GATE_OVERRIDE=1 in a session's environment lifts HOLD for that session. edit: the docs exempt from the 300-line cap. Check with: node .claude/hooks/policy.js

usage.holdAdvice: No new implementers (CLAUDE.md, Wave size). Finish work already in flight; a verifier for an already-launched task needs the owner's override. Otherwise wait for the reset or the owner's word.
